summary: Re-audit under T-02.2 rubric: Verified 7 ACs (AC-LEARN-03-01..07), negative apply cases, and RBAC enforcement.

fail_cases_tested: AC-LEARN-03-02: Non-human / agent attempting to apply proposal rejected with APPLY_FORBIDDEN
AC-LEARN-03-03: Applying already applied proposal rejected with ALREADY_APPLIED
AC-LEARN-03-06: Applying nonexistent proposal rejected with PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND

findings.description: Measurement window start time relies on server wall-clock; clock skew across distributed runners should be monitored.

invariants_checked: INV-KB-02: RBAC authorization ensures agent/machine calls are rejected with APPLY_FORBIDDEN (0 state modifications).
DM-PROPOSAL: Proposal schema constraints respected; non-empty revert definition verified.
Single Measurement Window: Duplicate apply throws ALREADY_APPLIED error, ensuring exactly one active window.
Immediate Measurement State: Newly applied proposal is stamped with status: 'applied', measurement_state: 'measuring', and never effective: true.
Idempotent Application: Applying with idempotent: true preserves version, timestamps, and structure without error.
Version increment: Version increments monotonically upon first apply.
